observations: Three separate courtyard buildings; red vertical timber with white corner and fascia trim.
Restaurant has orange tiled courtyard roof, small dark-cheeked gabled dormers, central large gable and white timber balcony supported by porch posts.
East annex has white ground-floor wall with several separate access doors and small high windows; red upper wall and tiled dormer roof.
West reception wing has red vertical-board end wall, white-framed upper gable window and brick chimney.
Gravel courtyard with clipped hedges, umbrellas, trolley parking, lamp post and central deciduous tree.
gaps: Tree obscures restaurant bays; image cannot establish true dimensions or current roof changes.

observations: Oblique overview ties restaurant rear elevation, two courtyard wings, kiosk, cart shelter, parking, camper pitches, paths and driving range together.
Restaurant rear has long white-glazed extension, dark roof with a run of small dormers, external plant/box at ground level, and paved terrace.
North facilities include small kiosk with white door/window panels and a long open-sided cart shelter.
Range starts beyond clubhouse with open mats and roofed building at woodland edge.
gaps: Filename suggests 2024-10-13; no verified capture timestamp. Oblique perspective is not metric.

facts: Site diagram labels detached west wing reception/kansli.

facts: East annex contains both lodging and changing rooms. Club offers 18 beds and access to showers and sauna.
gaps: All four elevations and post-renovation exterior survey unavailable.

facts: Kiosk/toilets are north of clubhouse by hole 9/10, with wash-up behind kiosk.

facts: Cart carport stands immediately south of kiosk. Report records a new carport during 2020.
gaps: Post/bay count and roof material need closeups.

facts: Range south of campus, with putting green between range and courtyard.
Existing mat row and roofed range structure have photographic evidence.
gaps: Facade closeups and precise existing bay count unavailable.

facts: Club documents 18 powered RV pitches: 12 on grass, six on gravel.
Current charging page documents seven charging posts with 14 charging spaces.
gaps: Do not assume all posts existed in older orthophotos.

facts: Club/ball wash with drinking water lies between clubhouse and putting green; roof pillars and notice-board works documented in 2020 report.
gaps: Exact small-roof identity and current fixtures need on-site closeups.

facts: Club posts identify separate on-course toilets at holes 5 and 15.
gaps: No verified facade photos or measured roof footprints captured in this campus photo search. Model only after positional evidence.

facts: Several small roofs occur around campus/range.
gaps: Do not identify a maintenance workshop, pump room, bag store or private building solely from roof appearance. Exact functions need primary evidence.

facts: 2024 proposal has measured drawings for a new ten-bay range and bag store.
Club December 2025 article plans project start autumn 2026.
gaps: Construction completion not verified. Studio has site footprint only in acquired drawing set, not detailed studio elevations.

chronology.event: Historical courtyard photographs published; useful for persistent building details, not modern alterations.
Carport built; kiosk and toilet with terrace constructed for completion by 2021 season; notice-board and ball-wash roof pillar work.
Restaurant rear terrace extension included in annual plan; completion not established by plan alone.
Water-damage demolition inside lodging/changing annex nearing completion; interior refurbishment discussed.
Site proposal 2A; floor/roof/section/facade drawings revised to proposal 3A on 2024-10-10.
Club announced funding and intended autumn 2026 start for new golfstudio and improved range.
Older panorama has orange restaurant rear main roof; drone and native ortho show dark rear roof. Capture dates/material changes not established.
